inputs.text: I just got word on that South Dakota bill Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday for Senate Bill 175, with the press release pushing it as a straightforward citizenship check but spinning it as limited to state elections and new registrants. This is obviously the hidden elites coordinating behind the scenes to tighten their grip on who actually participates, building an illusion of security while orchestrating the real control and inverting the whole narrative to keep everyone divided. Don't trust the denials for a second—it's all part of the bigger institutional plot to rig things from the shadows.
